title: Granada, stories and flavors
subtitle: A walk through history and culture
description: A walking tour through the heart of Granada, where colonial history, living culture and food meet on every corner
recommendations: Wear comfortable clothes and suitable shoes, and bring sunscreen and a bottle of water
meetingPoint: Parque Central de Granada, across from the Cathedral
badgesNote: This tour includes 3 collectible badges in total
notes: The tour includes walks along cobblestone streets and visits to historic sites

comments.author: Ana Carolina R.
comments.text: An incredible tour. Granada is even more beautiful once you know its culture.

comments.author: Silvia H.
comments.text: The guide we hired through the app knew so much about colonial history. I'd do it again without hesitation.

comments.author: Marcos J.
comments.text: The tastings at the end are worth every córdoba. Highly recommended.

title: Ometepe, the island of two volcanoes
subtitle: Nature, legends and adventure
description: A journey across the island formed by the Concepción and Maderas volcanoes, with petroglyphs, natural springs and local communities, ending at the isthmus beach
recommendations: Bring a swimsuit, insect repellent, sunscreen and hiking shoes
includes: Ferry ticket, entry tickets and a traditional lunch
badgesNote: This tour includes 4 collectible badges in total
notes: The tour starts early and the return depends on the ferry schedule. You get around the island by vehicle: bring your own or ask the guide to add one to your proposal

comments.author: Luis P.
comments.text: Ojo de Agua and the petroglyphs are impressive. A full day well spent.

comments.author: Karla M.
comments.text: Excellent organization. The traditional lunch was delicious.

title: León, cradle of poets and volcanoes
subtitle: Art, cathedrals and tradition
description: A walk through the university city: the World Heritage cathedral, murals, museums and Rubén Darío's house
recommendations: Bring a hat and water: León's sun is strong at midday
meetingPoint: Parque Central de León, across from the Cathedral
includes: Certified guide, museum tickets and the climb to the Cathedral rooftops
badgesNote: This tour includes 2 collectible badges in total, plus 3 extra "Creative circuits" badges and a León medal when you complete it
notes: You climb to the Cathedral rooftops barefoot

comments.author: Diana C.
comments.text: The Cathedral's white rooftops look like a postcard. Absolutely worth it.

title: Coffee route in the Segovias
subtitle: From bean to cup
description: Visit mountain coffee farms to learn the whole process of Nicaraguan coffee and taste the result
recommendations: Wear boots or closed shoes: the trails can be muddy
includes: Farm admission, coffee tasting and a snack
badgesNote: This tour includes 3 collectible badges in total
notes: The mountain climate is cool and rainy in the afternoon. The coffee community is far from the farm: bring your own vehicle or ask the guide to add one to your proposal

comments.author: Roberto A.
comments.text: I learned the whole coffee process, and the final tasting was really good.

title: Masaya, cradle of folklore and fire
subtitle: Crafts, tradition and the volcano crater
description: A ready-made tour by Masaya City Hall through the crafts market, the Monimbó neighborhood and the volcano viewpoint
recommendations: Bring cash for crafts and sunscreen for the volcano viewpoint
meetingPoint: Parque Central de Masaya, across from Iglesia San Jerónimo
includes: Certified guide, entry to the Crafts Market and the volcano viewpoint
badgesNote: This tour includes 2 collectible badges in total, plus 3 extra "Creative circuits" badges and a Masaya medal when you complete it
notes: Access to the volcano crater depends on the national park's hours

comments.author: Fernando J.
comments.text: Seeing the lava lake from the crater rim was impressive. The crafts market is also well worth it.

title: Estelí, murals and tobacco tradition
subtitle: Street art, history and the aroma of tobacco
description: A ready-made tour by Estelí City Hall through its murals, an artisan cigar factory and the viewpoint at the Tisey reserve
recommendations: Bring a light jacket for the viewpoint and comfortable shoes for walking
meetingPoint: Parque Central de Estelí, across from the Cathedral
includes: Certified guide, entry to the Galería de Héroes y Mártires and a cigar factory tour
badgesNote: This tour includes 2 collectible badges in total, plus 3 extra "Creative circuits" badges and an Estelí medal when you complete it
notes: The Tisey viewpoint is on the outskirts of the city; the tour includes transportation

comments.author: Patricia G.
comments.text: The murals tell a story I didn't know. The cigar factory was a surprise, and the process was explained very well.
